comparison.objective: Distinct: the record removes three spacer dowels to lower and irreversibly bond an aligned laminate sheet; the candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper through repeated dynamic carriage tests.
comparison.physical_skill: Distinct: dowel extraction while preserving sheet registration and managing compliant settling versus recessed hex-key engagement, bimanual counterholding, fine collar rotation, torque-limited relocking, and response-driven adjustment. Shared grasping/releasing primitives do not constitute overlap.
comparison.success_condition: Distinct: the record requires all three simulated panels bonded, released, registered within 6 mm x/8 mm y, retaining at least 2 mm edge overhang for 1 s. The candidate requires two consecutive ≥0.85 J cycles within the rated velocity range, ≤12 mm stroke, no hard-stop strike, overload, excessive rebound, or lock drift. Candidate rubric omits numeric rebound/overload limits and leaves the drift tolerance to be declared; these gaps do not plausibly duplicate the laminate criteria.
comparison.reason: The tasks test meaningfully different abilities: controlled removal of temporary supports during irreversible compliant sheet placement versus tool-mediated adjustment and retention of a mechanical energy absorber validated by dynamic response.
